children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Create recoverable snapshots, schedule retention-aware backups, and restore into a new or existing server with a verification plan.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A completed backup is only useful after you have verified its destination, metadata, and restore path.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Use per-server or global views to start snapshots, filter phases, and inspect destination, size, timestamps, and errors. From v0.3.0, the Backups page groups its filters in a popover on the right of the search row: Location (when several clusters are registered), Server and the current tab's Phase. Selections apply when you click Apply.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Record server identity, world path, destination, and backup phase.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Wait for completion before restarting, deleting, or wiping a server.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Use the detail drawer to capture logs and failure context before retrying.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Backups combine a cron schedule with a restic repository, credentials, and explicit retention policy.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Store repository credentials in labelled Kubernetes Secrets.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Trim Backup resources by retention; repository storage is not reclaimed automatically.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Watch active schedules and alert on missed or failed runs.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Restore into a new server for verification, or overwrite only after stopping writes. All-data captures check volume layout first.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Verify source backup, checksum, destination, and available storage

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Prefer a new server for validation; stop writes before overwrite

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Start, inspect events and logs, then test world and player data
